Kreative Kompas Engine's Forgejo Actions workflows (YAML): jobs that need no GPU move off the soucouyant runner. Heavy builds get `runs-on: windows-wsl`, quick checks `runs-on: ubuntu-latest` (any free Linux runner); the main build, benchmarks and VM tests stay on soucouyant.
